company_name: Ping An Insurance (Group) Company of China, Ltd.
model: Diversified financial FCFE at cost of equity on group operating profit attributable, net debt held at zero (engine route)

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: 5-year revenue, EPS and equity CAGRs straddle the IFRS 4 -> IFRS 17/9 break (1 Jan 2023) and are not like-for-like; 3-year figures use the FY2022 restated kpis (revenue 985,186, net income 111,008, equity 869,191). Equity 3yr 4.8% vs revenue 3yr 5.0% and EPS 3yr 6.5%: within 30%, no divergence flag on the comparable basis.
historical_growth.notes: fcf_*_cagr is the DPS series (FY2022 2.42 -> FY2025 2.70; FY2020 2.20 -> 2.70), the observed FCFE; reported OCF-capex is bank/insurance float and meaningless as FCF. OPAT 3yr: FY2022 restated ~147.0bn (43,820 / 29.8%) -> 134,415, i.e. operating profit is still below its FY2021-22 level after the 2023 assumption reset. EPS uses restated FY2022 NI 111,008 / 17,454M = 6.36 -> 7.68.

scenario_narratives.base: Recovery-then-fade: OPAT +8% in FY2026 (asset management back in profit, L&H flat-to-up, bank +3%), growth easing to 3.5% by FY2035; operating ROE ~12% against a 10.5% CoE, so retained earnings add a modest amount of value and payout rises from 37% to 70%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Integrated-finance flywheel works: bancassurance and agent productivity keep NBV growing high single digits, CSM release grows, bank credit normalises; operating ROE ~13.5% and OPAT compounds 6-9% before fading to 4%.
scenario_narratives.bear: Japan-style low-rate squeeze plus property credit: negative spread pressure, another EV assumption cut, bank impairments; OPAT falls ~10% by FY2028 and grows only with nominal GDP thereafter at an ROE below the cost of equity.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value what the shareholder of a Chinese financial conglomerate actually receives: the holdco dividend, funded from group operating profit attributable (OPAT), with payout tied to growth through payout = 1 - g/ROE, discounted at a CNY cost of equity. Cross-checks: (1) Group EV RMB1,567.8bn at 30 June 2026 = RMB82.4/share fully diluted (HKD96.9); the market price is ~0.5x EV, the usual deep discount for Chinese life EVs whose 4.0% investment-return and 8.5%-ish risk-discount assumptions the market does not believe. (2) Residual income on book: equity attributable RMB1,028.1bn = RMB54.0/share diluted; justified P/B = (ROE - g)/(CoE - g) = (12 - 3)/(10.5 - 3) = 1.2x -> ~RMB65 (HKD76), vs 0.79x at the current price; at a 9% ROE (bear) the justified P/B is 0.8x. (3) Separate parts: the 58.0% stake in Ping An Bank (19,405.9M shares, 000001.SZ RMB11.50 at the 2026-10-16 close) is worth RMB129bn at market = RMB6.8/share of Ping An, and at 0.48x its RMB271bn attributable operating equity; ex-bank, the current price capitalises the insurance, asset management and tech businesses at ~RMB680bn diluted against L&H EV RMB970.8bn and P&C operating equity RMB151.8bn. The engine's base sits between the dividend-yield floor and the EV/book reads, which is the expected ordering for a business earning a little above its cost of equity.
key_risks_to_valuation: Interest-rate spread: CGB 10y ~1.8% vs guaranteed rates on the in-force book; a further cut to the 4.0% EV long-run return would lower OPAT (L&H OPAT locks investment return at 4.0%)
Property/credit: debt schemes, WMPs and the bank loan book (NPL 1.05%, provision cover 219.6%); 2021's RMB35.9bn China Fortune Land impairment is the precedent
Payout path is the dominant lever: holding payout at 37% for ten years (no rise) cuts base value materially; regulators or solvency (Life comprehensive 185.5%) could force that
OPAT definition risk: OPAT locks L&H returns at 4.0% and excludes short-term investment variance; if realised returns persistently undershoot, OPAT overstates distributable profit
Equity-market exposure (~19% of the investment book) drives net profit and OCI, and therefore solvency and payout capacity
CB dilution: 2024 CB is in the money at HKD39.29; share count already assumes full conversion of both CBs

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API (2318.HK) at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 49.86-74.70. FX HKDCNY=X and A-share 601318.SS from the same endpoint (see inputs.fx_note).
data_sources.financials: 2318.HK_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, RMB millions) and kpis (IFRS 17 restated FY2022, dividends, LTSP purchases); FY2025 Annual Report (notes 39 LTSP, subsidiaries list); H1 2026 Interim Report (Financial Highlights, Operating Profit reconciliation and segment OPAT, Components of Economic Value, CB dilution table, EPS note 16, dividend payout table).

sanity_check_note: sanity_check.py passed (earnings_at_coe: pb and p_sales evaluated) but carries the known fx-direction bug (memory: sanity-check-fx-rate-direction-systemic-bug): historical FY-end HKD prices are multiplied by fx_rate 1.1758 instead of divided (FY2025 printed 85.48 vs a real ~HKD72.7), inflating historical multiples by fx^2 = 1.38x, and the implied multiples compare the HKD IV against RMB book (inflated by fx = 1.18x). Hand-bridged on a consistent RMB basis: implied P/B at the weighted IV = 1.364/1.1758 = 1.16x vs corrected 10yr range 0.55-2.97x (avg 1.48x); implied P/Sales 1.02x vs corrected 0.48-1.44x (avg 0.89x). Both inside range, so the pass is genuine on corrected figures. Note FY2017-22 book and sales are IFRS 4, FY2023+ IFRS 17/9.

inputs.base_revenue_note: FY2025 total revenue (IFRS 17/9 basis) per the FY2025 Annual Report consolidated income statement, as carried in core_metrics. Revenue is only the compounding base for the engine; the flow that matters is group operating profit after tax attributable to shareholders of the parent (OPAT), expressed as a margin on it. FY2022 restated (IFRS 17) revenue 985,186 is in kpis; pre-2023 core_metrics revenue is IFRS 4 and not comparable.
inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted on full conversion: 18,107,641,995 A+H shares in issue at 30 June 2026 (unchanged in H1 2026) + 695.5M H shares on the USD3.5bn 2024 CB at HKD39.29 (in the money) + 225.0M on the HKD11,765M 2025 CB at HKD52.30 (near the money) = 19,028.1M (H1 2026 interim report, CB dilution table). The issued count already includes the ~650M shares held by the Long-term Service Plan / KESPP trusts (weighted average outstanding ex-treasury 17,455M), so plan vesting adds nothing further; the cash cost of buying those shares is charged in sbc_pct_path instead. Converting both CBs means the CB principal is treated as equity, consistent with net debt held at zero. Held FLAT.
inputs.net_debt_treatment: Held at ZERO, the banks/insurers convention in this folder (1336.HK, 0998.HK, 2016.HK, LGEN.L, PRU). Bonds payable RMB718,649M at 30 June 2026 are overwhelmingly Ping An Bank interbank CDs and financial bonds plus insurance capital bonds -- operating funding whose interest is already deducted inside OPAT. Cash RMB626,854M is bank and policyholder liquidity, not shareholder surplus. The two H-share CBs are treated as converted (see share_count_basis). Holdco CB proceeds (USD3,461M + HKD11,668M, unused at 30 June 2026) earn income inside OPAT and are not added separately.
inputs.last_fcf_note: FY2025 cash dividends declared RMB48,891M = RMB2.70/share (interim 0.95 + final 1.75), 36.4% of OPAT 134,415 (H1 2026 interim report dividend table). This is the observed FCFE. Operating cash flow less capex (CSV 650,277 for FY2025) is bank deposit and insurance float movement, not free cash, so the identity last_fcf = reported_fcf - sbc - interest_income is deliberately not satisfied; reported_fcf is kept for auditability only.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 Annual Report note 39 (Long-term Service Plan): IFRS 2 expense RMB643M (2024: 498) is already inside OPAT; the cash cost of market purchases of H shares for the plan was RMB3,875M in 2025 (74.6M shares at RMB51.87), RMB3,540M in 2024, 4,451 in 2023, 4,439 in 2022 (kpis LTSPSharePurchases). Because the share count includes the trust-held shares, the economic cost of the plan is the cash spent buying them, so the house basis charges the purchase cost net of the expense already in OPAT: (3,875 - 643) / 1,140,324 = 0.28% of revenue. The street basis adds this back.
inputs.buyback_note: No buybacks for cancellation since 2022 (1,101M in 2022, 3,900M in 2021, kpis ShareRepurchases). LTSP purchases are compensation, not buybacks.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and flows are RMB (CNY) millions; the HKEX H-share quote is HKD. fx_rate converts model to quote: 1 CNY = 1.1758 HKD, inverted from Yahoo HKDCNY=X 0.8505 at 2026-10-17T21:32Z. Parity check against the Shanghai A share (601318.SS, identical economic rights) RMB51.88 at the 2026-10-16 close: 51.88 x 1.1758 = HKD61.00 vs the H share HKD50.05, i.e. the H trades ~18% below the A -- the structural A/H discount, which confirms the rate's direction and magnitude, not price parity. Per-share values are computed in CNY and converted; canonical intrinsic_value / weighted_iv / entry_price are HKD. refresh_price.py moves the price but not this rate.
inputs.price_as_of: 2026-10-16T08:08:14Z HKEX regular close (Friday); 52-week range 49.86-74.70, the price sits at the bottom of its range ahead of Q3 2026 results (late October)
inputs.wacc_rationale: Cost of EQUITY 10.5%, built in CNY because the flows are CNY: China 10-year government bond ~1.8% (approximate; no live CGB quote via the Yahoo chart endpoint) + beta ~1.2 x 6.5% China ERP = ~9.6%, plus ~1pt for conglomerate opacity (five regulated segments, SEHK public censure of directors in January 2026), the equity-heavy RMB6.5tn investment book (~19% equities) and H-share capital-controls/governance discount. Matches the folder's other Chinese insurers/banks (1336.HK 10.5%, 0998.HK 10.5%, 2016.HK 11%). One rate across scenarios; downside is carried in the bear path and its 30% weight.
inputs.lease_treatment: Not applicable: IFRS 16 charge is inside operating expenses already deducted in OPAT (lease liabilities RMB8.4bn at FY2025 against RMB13.9tn of assets).
inputs.nci_treatment: The flow is OPAT ATTRIBUTABLE to shareholders of the parent, which already excludes the non-controlling share (mainly the 42% of Ping An Bank not owned, and minorities in Ping An Life/P&C): H1 2026 OPAT to NCI 14,855 vs attributable 84,196. Equity NCI of RMB425,996M is therefore not deducted again.
inputs.notes: MODEL: FCFE (distributable OPAT) at cost of equity for a diversified Chinese financial conglomerate, run through the component engine with net debt at zero -- the same family as the folder's other Chinese insurers (1336.HK) and banks (0998.HK, 2016.HK). Routing: SKILL.md lists insurer -> BVPS x exit P/B and bank -> residual income; Ping An straddles both, so a separate-parts build was considered. It was NOT used as the engine because (a) group OPAT already sums the segments on an attributable basis (FY2025: L&H 103,265 of 134,415; banking ~25bn attributable; P&C ~14.6bn; asset mgmt loss), (b) dividends are paid by the holdco out of group OPAT, and (c) IFRS 17 book value understates the life business (CSM RMB737.8bn, Group EV RMB1,567.8bn vs equity RMB1,028.1bn) while OCI makes it volatile. The parts are used as CROSS-CHECKS (valuation_philosophy): Ping An Bank's listed stake, Group EV, and a justified-P/B residual-income read. ENGINE MAPPING: revenue = FY2025 total revenue; ebitda_margin_path = attributable OPAT / revenue (FY2023 11.4%, FY2024 10.7%, FY2025 11.8%; OPAT derived from the disclosed payout ratios 37.3%/37.9%/36.4%); cash_tax_rate = 0 and da = 0 because OPAT is already after tax, D&A and NCI; sbc_pct_path = 0.28% (LTSP cash purchases net of the expense already in OPAT); capex_pct_path is the RETENTION plug = margin x (1 - payout), so FCFE = revenue x (margin x payout - sbc). PAYOUT CONSISTENCY: retention must fund growth at the operating ROE (~12-13%), payout = 1 - g/ROE. Base starts at 37% (policy ~36% of OPAT, 14 years of rising DPS) and rises to 70% by year 10 as growth fades to 3.5% (1 - 3.5/12 = 71%), so the terminal flow is not capitalising a retention rate the business no longer needs. HISTORY CAUTION: OPAT has not grown since 2021 (147.7bn FY2021, ~147.0bn FY2022 restated, 118.0 FY2023, 121.9 FY2024, 134.4 FY2025, H1 2026 +8.3%), so the base path is a recovery-then-fade, not a continuation of a growth record. Net profit (134,778 FY2025; 92,585 H1 2026 +36%) is NOT used: it carries short-term investment variance (+4,166 H1 2026) and CB revaluation (+4,297).
inputs.segment_snapshot_note: H1 2026 OPAT attributable by segment (RMB M): L&H 52,885 (+0.9%), P&C 8,772 (-12.4%), Banking 14,894 (+3.3%), Asset management 9,172 (+236.8%, swing to profit), Finance enablement 132, Other/elims -1,660; group 84,196 (+8.3%). Operating equity: L&H 540,441, P&C 151,799, Banking 271,382, AM 71,340, Finance enablement 65,838. L&H NBV H1 2026 24,847 (+11.2%); CSM 737,775.

bear.payout_path_note: Implied payout of OPAT: 36, 37, 38, 40, 42, 45, 48, 51, 54, 57% (regulators and solvency hold retention up).
bear.narrative: Falling CGB yields squeeze the spread over guaranteed liabilities and the EV return assumption is cut again; property-linked credit hits the bank and the debt-scheme book; NBV stalls under the NFRA commission rules. OPAT drops to ~RMB120bn by FY2028 and stays there in real terms (operating ROE ~9%, below CoE), and payout rises only slowly.

base.payout_path_note: Implied payout of OPAT: 37, 39, 42, 46, 50, 54, 58, 62, 66, 70% (capex = margin x (1 - payout)).
base.narrative: FY2026 OPAT ~RMB145bn (+8%, in line with H1 2026 +8.3%) as asset management swings to profit and L&H holds; then growth fades from 6% to 3.5% as bancassurance commission caps and preset-rate cuts slow NBV and Ping An Bank's NIM stabilises near 1.8%. OPAT/revenue ~12%, operating ROE ~12%. Payout rises from the 37% policy level to 70% as growth slows.

bull.narrative: NBV compounds high single digits on bancassurance scale and margin gains; asset management stays profitable; P&C COR holds ~95%; bank NIM troughs and credit costs ease. OPAT back above its FY2021 peak by FY2027 and operating ROE climbs to ~13.5%.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 15x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear weighted above the 15% house default, matching 1336.HK: the downside is a China-specific systemic tail (CGB yields at record lows vs guaranteed liabilities, property-linked credit in both the bank and the RMB6.5tn investment book, NFRA product/commission intervention) that a single conglomerate cannot diversify away, and OPAT has not grown since 2021. Bull held at 20% because the bull path needs both the life business and the bank to improve together.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
